abstract: Discover how TELUS Digital helps clients transform their customer support operations through a strategic partnership with AWS Partner Zendesk, leveraging generative AI to create an innovative asynchronous messaging solution. This session dives deep into how the integration of AI-powered tools within digital and app channels leads to remarkable improvements in customer satisfaction, including a 5-point increase in First Contact Resolution and a 50% reduction in after-contact work time. The solution not only enables 24/7 customer support and enhanced operational agility during peak periods but also provides valuable data-driven insights for continued service optimization. This presentation is brought to you by TELUS, an AWS Partner.
title: Revolutionizing Customer Experience: The TELUS Digital Success Story (sponsored by TELUS Digital)

abstract: More global leaders like Bundesliga and Trellix are taking their generative AI applications to production and realizing business impact through increased innovation, productivity, and cost savings. Weâll show you how to unify data from multiple silos, orchestrate tooling and governance, and navigate complex multi-cloud environments. The goal? Understand and prepare for the age of agents. This presentation is brought to you by Boomi, an AWS Partner.

abstract:
The landscape of application development has transformed over the past two decades, shifting from monolithic architectures to complex, distributed, non-deterministic systems. This evolution impacts not only building and deployment but also observability and monitoring.

In this talk, we'll dive into the complexities of a modern application stack, discussing goals for modernization and alignment with frameworks such as AWS Well-Architected. We'll also explore how AI and Large Language Models are redefining observability through anomaly detection, predictive analytics, and AI-driven root cause analysis.

Join us as we connect the dots between application modernization practices and observability challenges. This presentation is brought to you by Datadog, an AWS Partner.
room: Level 800, Hall D - Blue Silent Stage
title: Observability for Your AWS Modernization Journey (sponsored by Datadog)
